business_summary: SANKEI REAL ESTATE Inc. was incorporated under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations. With Sankei Building Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, the Asset Management Company) as the organizer, The Sankei Building Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, SANKEI BUILDING or Sponsor) as the sponsor, and investments in capital of 100 million yen (1,000 units) on November 19, 2018, and completed the registration with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau pursuant to Article 187 of the Investment Trusts Act on December 17, 2018 (Registration No. 140 with the Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau). Later, SANKEI REAL ESTATE was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter, the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on March 12, 2019 (TSE code: 2972). In October 2023, SANKEI REAL ESTATE converted from an office-building-oriented REIT to a comprehensive REIT due to partial amendments in its management guidelines of the Asset Management Company. As of the last day of the fiscal period under review (February 28, 2025), the total number of investment units issued and outstanding was 467,099 units and unitholders' capital (net) was 49,435 million yen. SANKEI REAL ESTATE Inc. was established on November 19, 2018 and incorporated in Japan.
business_summary_ko: SANKEI REAL ESTATE Inc.는 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률에 따라 설립되었습니다. Sankei Building Asset Management Co., Ltd.(이하 자산운용회사)를 주관사로 The Sankei Building Co., Ltd.(이하 SANKEI BUILDING 또는 Sponsor)를 후원자로 하여 2018년 11월 19일에 자본금 1억엔(1,000단위)을 출자하여 12월 17일에 투자신탁법 제187조에 따라 관동지방재무국에 등록을 완료하였습니다. 2018년(관동지방재정국장 등록번호 제140호) 이후 SANKEI REAL ESTATE는 2019년 3월 12일에 도쿄 증권 거래소(이하, 도쿄 증권 거래소)의 부동산 투자 신탁 증권 시장에 상장되었습니다(TSE 코드: 2972). 2023년 10월 SANKEI REAL ESTATE는 자산운용사 운용 지침의 일부 개정으로 인해 오피스 빌딩 중심 REIT에서 종합 REIT로 전환했습니다. 검토 대상 회계연도 마지막 날(2025년 2월 28일) 현재 발행 및 미결제 총 투자 단위 수는 467,099 단위이며 단위 보유자 자본(순)은 49,435백만입니다.
